content: Admission Inquiry Academics Faculty of Medicine & Healthcare KPGU's Faculty of Medicine & Healthcare in Vadodara offers PCI-approved B.Pharm, M.Pharm courses, GSCPT approved B.PT, M.PT and NCISM approved B.A.M.S. programs. 0 Constituent Schools 0+ Programs Offered PCI, AYUSH and GSCPT Approvals 0+ Hospital MoU Partners Constituent schools Explore Our Schools Three constituent schools - KSP, KAMC, and KSPR - offering 10+ accredited healthcare programs in Pharmacy, Ayurveda, and Physiotherapy. Each school combines rigorous academics with clinical training to build healthcare professionals ready for a rapidly evolving industry. KSP Pharmacy Programs & Ph.D. Programs Krishna School of Pharmacy & Research 6 Programs Currently Viewing KAMC Ayurveda Program Krishna Ayurved Medical College & Matrusri Davalba Ayurved Hospital 4 Programs KSPR Physiotherapy Programs & Ph.D. Programs Krishna School of Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation 4 Programs KSP Message from the Director Dr. Falgun A. Mehta Professor & Director, KSP Pharmacists are essential pillars of modern healthcare. Pharmaceutical science is one of India's fastest-growing career sectors - and the global demand for skilled pharma professionals has never been greater, a reality underscored by the COVID-19 pandemic's profound impact on health systems worldwide. Krishna School of Pharmacy & Research (KSP) was established in 2005 as Babaria Institute of Pharmacy and is now a constituent school of Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU), Vadodara. KSP is approved under Section 12 by the Pharmacy Council of India. KSP offers B.Pharm, M.Pharm specializations in Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Technology, and Pharmacology, along with Ph.D. in Pharmaceutical Sciences - providing a complete, career-spanning pharmacy education pathway. Our campus features fully equipped pharmaceutical laboratories, advanced analytical instrumentation, multimedia-enabled classrooms, a central library, and a dedicated medicinal plant garden - bridging academic learning with real industry practice. Students benefit from an active academic ecosystem: industry seminars, Faculty Development Programs, industrial visits, NSS initiatives, and SSIP-led innovation pathways guiding students from ideation through patent filing and startup mentorship. With consistently strong academic results and mentorship-driven faculty, KSP has earned its reputation as one of Vadodara's leading pharmacy schools - producing graduates who are technically skilled, innovation-ready, and committed to better healthcare outcomes. Key Highlights B.Pharm course is accredited by National Board of Accreditation(NBA), New Delhi from 2022 to 2025 (second cycle) Approved under Section 12 by the Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) Rated 4-Star by GSIRF - Gujarat State Institutional Rating Framework Active SSIP Innovation Cell supporting research, patent filing, and startup development Infrastructure & Facilities Fully equipped pharmaceutical laboratories for hands-on training Advanced analytical instrumentation facilities Multimedia-enabled smart classrooms Central library and dedicated medicinal plant garden VALUES & GOALS Vision & Mission Our Vision “To contribute in effective global health care by leadership in pharmacy education, advancing research and merging entrepreneurial spirit with compassion” Our Mission To prepare pharmacists with strong scientific foundation fused with critical thinking, problem solving capacity, leadership & entrepreneurship skills in community and the profession through global collaboration leading to enhancement of health and quality of life in the society OUTCOME FOCUS Program Educational Objectives (PEOs) Knowledge The budding Pharmacy Graduates, as an integral part of the health care team, will be having strong theoretical and fundamental knowledge to contribute to the advancement of pharmaceutical sciences and public health. They will also possess necessary practical skill set in manufacturing of drugs of best quality and excel in patient counseling, to alleviate sufferings of humanity Core Competence To provide students with a solid foundation in fundamentals and advances of Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, Pharmacology and Pharmacognosy, as per the requirement of Pharmaceutical Industries, Community and Hospital Pharmacy, and pharmaceutical marketing. The Program aims to make students competent for future, by making them industry ready. Multidisciplinary Approach To train students with good knowledge along with practical efficiency in Pharmacodynamics, pharmacokinetics, Drug properties, synthesis, molecular modeling, formulation & development, analytical aspects in research and design with the help of industrial visits and guest lectures. Enable them to extend this knowledge to create novel Herbal & Synthetic Pharmaceutical products for the benefit of life. Professional Skills To inculcate in students professional and ethical attitude, team work skills, trouble shooting attitude, effective communication skills, multidisciplinary approach, and an ability to relate pharmaceutical sciences issues to broader social context. Global Presence Graduates of the program, as a global healthcare professional, need to involve in international activities like participation in international conference, International student exchange program, collaborative research, pursuing higher studies along with employment in overseas. Establishing channels that facilitate closer ties between overseas alumni and graduate students provides crucial benefits like inspiration, reputation, and financial support.
